shortBio.en: Sonic Youth bassist/vocalist; spoken/sung delivery inside noise-indie forms.
shortBio.zh: Sonic Youth 贝斯/人声；噪声 indie 形式里的说/唱交付。

whyHub.en: Sonic Youth → solo/art projects: noise-indie vocal/bass as separate brand after 2011.
whyHub.zh: Sonic Youth → 独唱/艺术项目：2011 后噪声 indie 人声/贝斯成独立品牌。

body.en:
Born 1953. Bass and vocal on Sister / Daydream Nation / Dirty. Band ends 2011; solo and art work continue.

Hub: NYC noise-rock personnel that outlasts the logo.
body.zh:
1953 年生。Sister / Daydream Nation / Dirty 上贝斯与人声。2011 乐队结束；独唱与艺术工作继续。

枢纽：纽约 noise-rock 人事可脱离 logo 存续。
